injuries.description: anterior cruciate ligament ("ACL") tear of the left knee; left ACL reconstruction performed
source: On 28 October 2006, left knee arthroscopy was performed as the Plaintiff he suffered from anterior cruciate ligament (“ACL”) tear.
On 22 March 2007, left ACL reconstruction was performed, followed by physiotherapy for rehabilitation.

manifestations.description: The Plaintiff still complains of residual pain on his left knee after walking for about 30 minutes, or standing for about 20 minutes, or squatting, sitting for one to two hours.
There is stiffness of his left knee.
He is scared of driving motorcycle again.
He is able to squat with slight modification.
The Plaintiff is independent in his activities of daily living.
He does not need any walking aid and goes out using public transportation without restriction.

losses.description: Reduction in monthly salary from HKD 11,000 to HKD 7,000 because he could not lift heavy goods; claims for pre-trial and post-trial loss of earning and loss of earning capacity.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: He is scared of driving motorcycle again.
